claim: L0 (LFP-primary analysis spec BLOCKER): reconciled Andre's 'no omission LFP response in any area/band' vs Hamed's 'effect visible per-channel, vanishes when pooled' by computing the omission response 4 ways (per-channel-then-pool / pool-then-power / per-channel-dB-then-average / CSD-referenced) on one session/area/band.
implementation: context/figures/L0_pooling_reconciliation/L0_pooling_reconciliation.py, reusing existing jnwb infra (precompute_tfr_arrays.resolve_lfp_datasets/p1_onsets_s, jnwb.artifact_repair.repair_lfp_trials, jnwb.addressing.map_peak_channel_to_area, jnwb.spectral.laplacian_reference as the CSD estimator -- no new CSD infrastructure built, laplacian_reference's nearest-neighbor spatial Laplacian is the standard discrete CSD estimator for a linearly-spaced depth-ordered probe).
csd_determination: jnwb.spectral.laplacian_reference reused directly for L0 method (d) and flagged as the candidate for L4's CSD requirement too -- not confirmed with Hamm yet, just the natural existing-infra choice per the project's reuse-over-reinvention convention and omission-signal skill's own recommendation of laplacian_reference as the 'preferred' re-referencing method.

run.channel_window: 32 contiguous depth-adjacent channels, local indices 48:80 (tractability choice, not all 128)

result_this_cell.interpretation: On THIS session/area/band, methods (a)/(b)/(c) agree closely (CIs heavily overlapping) -- does NOT reproduce Hamed's vanishes-when-pooled pattern. CSD-referenced (d) shows a smaller-magnitude but same-sign effect, consistent with some (not all) of the raw effect being volume-conducted/shared-reference rather than a local generator, but not a qualitative reversal.

canonical_pooling_method_rationale: Methodological determination per omission-signal skill S1 (log-last doctrine), not something one data point could prove/disprove on its own -- written to L0_stats.json as the field L1-L12 must read and fail loudly if absent, per the LFP spec's own acceptance criterion.

synthetic_acceptance_test.design: Equal-and-opposite superficial/deep dipole (8 channels +sin(2*pi*11*t), 8 channels -sin(2*pi*11*t), alpha band, response window only, noise floor both windows).
synthetic_acceptance_test.result: method (a) = 42.5 dB (real effect), method (b) = -0.67 dB (null, cancels) -- PASS, matches spec's stated acceptance criterion for L0.
synthetic_acceptance_test.also_verified: determinism (same seed -> byte-identical dB), degenerate zero-signal input stays finite (no NaN).

not_yet_done: Only ONE session/area/band cell has been run. This does NOT generalize to 'the Andre/Hamed discrepancy is resolved' -- that would require sweeping this same 4-method comparison across multiple areas/bands/sessions (a natural L1+ scope item) before any general claim about where/whether pooling erases a real per-channel effect on this corpus.
downstream_gate: L1-L12 (per the LFP spec's dependency graph) must read canonical_pooling_method from L0_stats.json and fail loudly if L0 has not been run -- not yet wired into any L1+ script since none exist yet.
